cases.translation: Completely destroyed them with their cities
cases.explain: Instrumental case is used after the preposition 'с' meaning with

cases.sentence: Тронулись в путь по дороге к ___
cases.translation: Set out on the road toward the sea
cases.explain: Dative case is used after the preposition 'к' meaning toward

cases.translation: Complained against God and against Moses
cases.explain: Accusative case is used after the verb 'роптали' meaning complained

cases.sentence: Сделай ___ и укрепи его на шесте
cases.translation: Make a serpent and set it on a pole
cases.explain: Accusative case is used as the direct object after the verb 'сделай'
Prepositional case is used after the preposition 'на' when indicating location

cases.translation: Moses sent messengers to speak to Sihon
cases.explain: Accusative case is used as the direct object after the verb 'послал'

cases.translation: I have delivered him into your hand
cases.explain: Accusative case is used after the preposition 'в' when indicating direction
Instrumental case is used after the verb 'завладели' meaning possessed

reading.ru: Когда хананский царь Арада услышал, что Израиль идет по Атаримской дороге, он напал на израилетян и взял некоторых из них в плен.
reading.question: What did the king of Arad do when he heard Israel was coming?
options: He attacked the Israelites and took some captive
reading.correct: He attacked the Israelites and took some captive
reading.explain: The text says 'он напал на израилетян и взял некоторых из них в плен' - he fought against Israel and took some captive

reading.ru: Если ты отдашь этот народ в наши руки, мы полностью уничтожим его города.
reading.question: What did Israel vow to do if God delivered their enemies?
options: To completely destroy the enemy cities
reading.correct: To completely destroy the enemy cities
reading.explain: The text states 'мы полностью уничтожим его города' - we will completely destroy their cities

reading.ru: Тогда Господь наслал на них ядовитых змей.
reading.question: What did the Lord send on the people?
reading.explain: The text says 'Господь наслал на них ядовитых змей' - The Lord sent venomous snakes upon them

reading.ru: Моисей сделал медного змея и укрепил его на шесте.
reading.question: What did Moses do to provide healing?
options: He made a bronze serpent and set it on a pole
reading.correct: He made a bronze serpent and set it on a pole
reading.explain: The text says 'сделал медного змея и укрепил его на шесте' - made a bronze serpent and set it on a pole

reading.ru: Израиль послал вестников, чтобы сказать Сигону царю Амореев.
reading.question: Why did Israel send messengers to Sihon?
options: To ask permission to pass through his land
To invite him to a feast
reading.correct: To ask permission to pass through his land
reading.explain: Israel was seeking passage through Sihon's territory, asking for safe conduct through his land

reading.ru: Израиль предал его мечу и завладел его землей от реки Арнона до реки Ябокка.
reading.question: What happened after Israel defeated Sihon?
options: They made a treaty with him
They took his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok
They divided it among the tribes
reading.correct: They took his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok
reading.explain: The text states 'завладел его землей от реки Арнона до реки Ябокка' - took possession of his land from the river Arnon to the river Jabbok
